purpose: The allocation law, engine release gate, engine stack parameters, operating modes, shield, reference baselines and benchmark code were frozen after development and before any run on the held-out seeds. SHA-256 is authoritative; program fingerprints are valid only under fingerprint_python.
selection: Base constants and engine stack parameters were selected by random search (81 configurations) and local refinement (61) on development seeds 1000 and 2000, minimising energy subject to a service floor. The equation (2) release gate thresholds (0.005 power-protect, 0.01 throughput) and the throughput constants were then selected by a joint search (121 configurations) requiring scale reversals at or below the Kubernetes reference, time healthy >= 0.90, recovery <= 17.5 min, backlog <= 2%, physical violations <= 8.5%, work completed >= 99.9% and zero invariant violations excluding I4; one configuration met every constraint and is used here. A headroom term driven by the same push was tested and rejected (higher energy, no service gain).
code_fingerprint_method: tools/code_fingerprint.py: SHA-256 of ast.dump with comments and docstrings removed (interpreter-version dependent)
post_registration_notes: Provenance: results/development/throughput_search_round1.jsonl and throughput_search_round2.jsonl (110 configurations) are result records of an earlier throughput-mode search whose generating script is not in the package. The throughput constants were subsequently re-evaluated by the recorded joint search (results/development/joint_search.py, JOINT_121.jsonl), in which no configuration met all constraints with lower energy.

Added after the held-out runs, without changing any pre-registered file: benchmarks/multiplicity.py (primary endpoint energy_kwh; secondary metrics Holm-adjusted), a two-mode soak with memory checkpoints, a C++ contract smoke test, and verify.py --full-replay.

amendments.change: Fleet mode (FLEET_MODE, FLEET_DECISION_SECONDS, mode_law('fleet')) was added for the 15-second fleet harness. The power_protect and throughput laws are unchanged; verify.py --full-replay regenerates every held-out RUNS.csv and SUMMARY.json of this benchmark byte-identically with the amended file.

The equation (2) add gate (push_add, default -9.0: never binding) and the fleet_balanced and fleet_wear settings were added. power_protect and throughput behaviour is unchanged; verify.py --full-replay regenerates every held-out RUNS.csv and SUMMARY.json of this benchmark byte-identically.
